title: Bed bends and can fall apart!!! Dangerous!!!
text:
Bed bends and can fall apart!!! Dangerous!!!. We’ve had this bed for 6 months in a guest room. 6 people have slept on it for a night at most two!
This morning I was making the bed for a friend arriving tonight and the bed felt unstable- this is what we found underneath!!!
We are horrified. Our dogs play in this room and this can collapse at any moment. We are rushing to find a blow up mattress. Terrible!
